scope: Google protobuf wire encoding of a 6-field float container message for 4 sign/presence cases, compared against the Rust prost encoder. Not protojson, not a descriptor-pool test, not a live server path.
corpus_provenance: cases.json is NEWLY AUTHORED. FloatContainers is a Rust-only #[derive(Message)] struct at crates/lk-protocol/tests/protobuf_negative_zero.rs:5-19 with no upstream .proto, so both the .proto and the 4-case sign/presence matrix are authored here to match that derive exactly (field numbers, scalar kinds, labels, map key/value kinds, proto3 optional presence).
map_order_note: The Rust consumer stores maps in a BTreeMap (sorted). Go default proto.Marshal leaves map iteration order unspecified, so wire_base64 comes from MarshalOptions{Deterministic:true}. The producer also probes 8 default marshals per case and records default_marshal_order_stable so the ordering instability is evidence, not an assumption.
